verdict.rationale: Veo is a video-generation model that is called by clients. It is not an agent or host that acts as an MCP client using external tools, so plugging MCP servers into it is outside this product category. Mentions of the Interactions API and the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform are host-platform features, and nothing shows Veo itself consuming MCP servers or tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
